info.name: SPVDirect API
info.description:
All SPVDirect backend endpoints, with Postman tests. Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner (in order) against a running backend (`npm run dev` in `backend/`).

Setup: the dev server uses HTTPS with a self-signed certificate (`npm run cert:dev`), so turn off *Settings → SSL certificate verification* in Postman. Cookies (`spv_session`, `spv_anaf_oauth`) are kept by Postman's cookie jar for `localhost`.

Variables: `baseUrl`, `email`, `password`, `cui` (a real CUI; creating a company looks it up at ANAF). `accountantId`, `companyId`, `connectionId` and `linkToken` are filled in by the test scripts.

Safety: the run deletes only a company it created itself (`companyCreatedByRun`). *Delete connection* revokes the certificate's tokens at ANAF, so it is skipped unless you set `allowConnectionDelete` to `true`. *Delete account* deletes the account the run logged in with, so it is skipped unless you set `allowAccountDelete` to `true`. Requests that need an ANAF connection are skipped until one exists: connect a certificate in the browser (`/accountants/:accountantId/anaf/connect`) and run again.

Register and Login are throttled to 10 requests per minute; creating or refreshing a company to 20 per minute.

request.description: Public. Returns `{ "status": "ok" }`.

request.description: Both fields optional: `name` (1-255 chars) and `anafConnectionId` (integer id of an own connection, or `null` to detach). Linking a different certificate first asks ANAF (`listaMesajeFactura?zile=1&cif=<CUI>`) whether it has SPV rights for the company's CUI; without them the answer is 400 "Certificatul nu are drept în SPV pentru CUI ..." and nothing is saved. Rate limited to 20/min. The pre-request script adds `anafConnectionId` when `connectionId` is set; the test accepts that 400 when the certificate is not authorized for the test CUI.

item.name: SPV archive
item.description: Saved SPV messages. SPVWS2 does not accept ANAF OAuth tokens (docs/adr/0001-no-spv-inbox-over-oauth.md), so the list is imported from the browser: open https://webserviced.anaf.ro/SPVWS2/rest/listaMesaje?zile=60 with your certificate, save the JSON and send it to the import request.

item.name: Import SPV messages (choose the ANAF JSON file)

request.description: Multipart field `file`: the JSON ANAF shows at listaMesaje (up to 5 MB, 10000 messages). Pick the saved file in the Body tab before sending. Returns `{ fetched, added, title, certSerial, notice, rights, unknownCuis }`; messages already saved are skipped. `rights` counts the CUI/CNPs in the list's `cui` field; `unknownCuis` are those CUIs (CNPs left out) that are not companies of the accountant yet. "Nu exista mesaje..." from ANAF imports nothing and comes back in `notice`. 60 requests/min.

exec: pm.test('Asks for the ANAF list', () => pm.expect(errorMessage()).to.include('lista de mesaje primită de la ANAF'));

request.description: Multipart field `document`: the PDF downloaded from https://webserviced.anaf.ro/SPVWS2/rest/descarcare?id=<anafMessageId> (up to 10 MB, must start with %PDF-). Saves it on the archived message and returns the message.

Returns 204, or 409 while an invoice is being sent to ANAF. A monthly job erases the rows and their Storage files 30 days later. request.description: Soft delete of the whole account: the account, its companies and all their data get `deleted_at`, ANAF certificates are revoked (best-effort) and removed, and the session cookie is cleared. 409 while an invoice is being sent to ANAF. The email can register again right away; the monthly purge erases the data 30 days later. Skipped unless `allowAccountDelete` is `true`.
